changeSet.author: sondos
changeSet.sql: CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW reports.vwdiagnostictestrequest AS SELECT dtr.id, dtr.status, dtr.type, dtr.name, dtr.indication, dtr.rejected_date, dtr.approved_date, dtr.rejected_by, dtr.approved_by, dtr.rejected_reason, dtr.diagnostic_test_id, dtr.from_department_id, dtr.from_facility_id, dtr.created_date, dtr.created_by, dtr.last_modified_by, dtr.last_modified_date FROM public.diagnostic_test_requests dtr;

changeSet.author: sondos
changeSet.sql: GRANT USAGE ON SCHEMA reports TO report_user;
GRANT SELECT ON reports.vwdiagnostictestrequest TO report_user;

rollback.sql: REVOKE SELECT ON reports.vwdiagnostictestrequest FROM report_user;
